title: Announcement timetable, sprint simulations, and fallback routes for cross-channel launch
creator: Priya Nambiar
description: Coordinate blog, email, social, and webinar outputs for the upcoming feature GA. Deliver a consolidated timeline with simulation runs for different delay scenarios, a single source of truth for release notes slices by audience, and explicit fallback routing rules (e.g., model fallback, region fallback, announcement delay windows). Reduce ambiguity for comms and SE teams and ensure a testable runbook for the 48h pre/post launch window.

Action items created: update social copy for delay scenario and adjust email drip schedule. Noted PRs: github.com/redwood/marketing/pull/274 and github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/9814.
acceptance_criteria: Single timeline spreadsheet that can be toggled between 'normal' and 'delayed' modes
Release notes separated into internal ops, customer highlights, and developer docs
Fallback rules documented: model variant fallback, regional delay windows, and communication owner matrix
All legal/compliance flags resolved and signoff received
Dry-run complete: one end-to-end rehearsal of email+blog+social+webinar with stakeholders present
